items.headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K2.6
items.summary: Kimi K2.6 is an open-weight successor to K2.5 focused on long-horizon coding and agent workflows, with Agent Swarm scaled to 300 sub-agents and 4,000 coordinated steps. Moonshot reports 58.6 on SWE-Bench Pro and 66.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.0; it is available on Kimi.com, the Kimi app, the API and Kimi Code.
